title: Hold a well driller's licence
what: Undertake well works only under a well driller's licence, or as an employee under a licensee's on-site supervision.

sources.title: Water Management Act 1999 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not physically undertake well works unless the person – (a) holds a licence (in this Division called a "well driller's licence" ); or (b) is an employee of, and working under the on-site supervision of, a person referred to in paragraph (a)

administration.who: Secretary of the Department administering the Water Management Act 1999 (Tas)
